name: YN ATV Lord
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve locs, goggles/headwear, cheek bandage, white tank, dark harness/trousers, gold jewelry, gloves/sneakers and white/black/gold quad. Review exactly four wheels, coherent suspension/handlebars, secured rear passenger, one complete barrel roll and full vehicle end framing.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns. Use character-specific effects and props; do not add a recurring golden-fist emblem or generic fist-shaped power effect.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

YN ATV Lord — Hop On.
IDENTITY: exact young adult brown-skinned ATV rider from the reference, long black locs, amber goggles on dark riding headwear, small cheek bandage, white tank top, black cross-body harness, baggy black graphic trousers, black riding gloves, layered gold jewelry and white/black/gold sneakers. Preserve the rugged FOUR-WHEEL white/black/gold quad with chunky tires, gold suspension springs and white headlights. Keep the rider's face visible beneath the lifted goggles.
0–1.2s: establish the complete rider AND quad in his relaxed perched pose. He spots a small orange padded passenger mannequin tumbling through cyan, swings both legs into proper riding position and revs hard. The front wheels lift into a huge wheelie as his left hand reaches toward the falling mannequin.
1.2–3.2s: whip sideways with the speeding quad. He scoops the mannequin securely onto the rear seat in one clean motion; a black rear-seat safety strap visibly clicks around it. Camera pulls WAY back as the quad launches fifty feet through empty cyan toward an isolated huge red stunt ramp, a finite curved object with no road or scenery. The tires touch the ramp's lip for one forceful spring-loaded takeoff, all four suspension units compressing then extending.
3.2–4.8s: rider, quad and secured passenger perform ONE enormous aerial barrel roll. Two heavy black training spheres converge toward the passenger; the rider twists the quad so its armored front skid plate meets them instead, knocking both away in a spectacular simultaneous bounded ivory/amber impact star. The machine completes the roll upright, wheels and passenger attached in correct positions. One clear rescue-to-protection stunt, no collision with the passenger, no duplicate vehicle.
4.8–6s: snap toward his confident face as the quad drops into a controlled nose-up hover, suspension settling visibly. Exact title HOP ON slams below his shoulders with a huge engine-and-metal impact. Keep the rider, mannequin and all four wheels recognizable on cyan.
6–8s: pull back for a complete quad-and-rider hero pose. He gives a casual two-finger salute, then notices the mannequin leaning sideways and nudges it upright with his elbow without looking back. One little puff of warm gray exhaust curls from the rear and dissipates on cyan. SFX: engine rev, tire growl, seat-strap CLICK, huge takeoff burst, rotating flyby, dominant double skid-plate CRASH, title slam, suspension clunks and fading motor idle. No music, dialogue, road, landscape or full-frame smoke.
